decisions.reason: The existing message-510 MODIFY already captures the main board's flexible prototype dimensions, middle position through the enclosure board order, top cable access, and permitted side placement for smaller connectors.
The existing message-510 MODIFY already captures the power board's vertical orientation, right-side position, flexible prototype dimensions, and connector-access layout.
The mechanical board order and connector-access guidance do not change the monitored rails, monitor placement, IC selection, or current coverage.
The source specifies physical enclosure placement but does not change the established electrical chain of power board to main board to sensor board or its distribution behavior.
Permission to place smaller connectors on the sides affects mechanical layout, not the main board's connector inventory, count, types, or destinations.
The source changes physical placement guidance but does not alter the sensor board's connector count, connector families, pin counts, or pinouts.
The general permission for smaller side connectors does not require relocating the battery connector from its established back-side position or changing its electrical interface.
The source does not change the panel controls, GPIO mappings, connection mode, or power-button connector behavior.
Mechanical board placement and prototype dimension flexibility do not affect the DCDC1 voltage setpoint, configuration interface, or compensation rule.
The source provides mechanical access guidance but does not change the interboard connector architecture, connector types, signals, pin-order policy, or matching-numbering requirement.
The physical arrangement of the three boards does not change the charge-status indicator, CHGLED connector, resistor values, or population settings.
The source does not change the status LED supply voltage, direct logic drive, level-shifter policy, LED model, or separate power-control behavior.
